title: Évaluation sommative du programme conjoint « Éducation pour tous » à Madagascar de 2015 à 2021 - Rapport final
why_not: Says only that the last Plan sectoriel de l'éducation ran 2018-2022 and a new one was in development; no plan for a learner record system, the SIGE appears only as a data source for the census figures, and the document predates the 36-month governance window.
